item: row 367: the Sources section follows a language switch
summary: Eight app-sources.js renderers held through ooLive/ooLiveHtml: the filter summaries (Any, N selected), the AI check's busy word, result line (canary warning first) and label, the source trail panel (a drill list opened inside lets the hold go), the import's unreadable-country sentence in its own node, the single and batch feed results with their hovers and the batch table (its headers now keyed), the batch picker's empty, failed and capped lines, and the retired-mode notice.
